key_insight: CFDTwin facilitates efficient surrogate modeling for CFD simulations, enabling faster design optimization and uncertainty analysis.
engineering_relevance: The tool significantly reduces the computational burden of thermal-fluid design workflows in engineering applications.
method: Utilizes proper orthogonal decomposition and neural-network (POD-NN) techniques.
Provides a GUI and scriptable Python API for easy user interaction.
Supports batch simulations in ANSYS Fluent with model validation capabilities.
evidence_signal: The tool can train POD-NN surrogate models while maintaining the physical interpretability of modal structures.
watch_item: Users may encounter limitations in scaling the tool for extremely large or complex simulations.
paper_title: CFDTwin: An open-source GUI and Python toolkit for POD-NN surrogate modeling of ANSYS Fluent simulations
